name: Jochuu Ukiyo no Kaidan
source:
Tonight, this young lady doesn't want to sleep yet, so she tells you a ghost story about love until she feels sleepy. Would you like to spend a chilling night with her?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23843]Freem![/url]]
translation:
今晚，这位小姐姐还不想睡，所以她给你讲了一个关于爱情的鬼故事，直到她困了为止。你想和她一起度过一个寒冷的夜晚吗？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23843]Freem![/url]]
